text:
nora-docs: Quick thread  opened a tiny PR to fix a handful of inconsistent observability snippets and one dead anchors in the Console docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9786
pat-eng: Thanks! Which files are affected?
nora-docs: console/observability/cost.md and console/examples/tracehook.md. The cost example still references `trace_key` and the SDK snippets use mixed casing. Also the presets anchor in cost.md 404s.
sylvia-ml: Runtime emits `traceId` now; worth standardizing examples to that. We also renamed the cost field to `estimated_cost_usd` in telemetry.v1.
dom-sdk: I'll push minimal Node + Python snippet fixes to the PR branch. Proposal for Node:
```js
// normalize telemetry and attach to tracehook
const data = { traceId: payload.traceId || payload.trace_key, estimated_cost_usd: payload.estimated_cost_usd || payload.estimated_cost }
tracehook.record(data)
```
ivy-ux: Tiny UX ask: change screenshot caption from "Cost by tracekey" to exactly "Cost by trace ID" (sentence case). Update alt text too.
link-bot: Found broken anchor: /docs/console/presets#legacy-presets -> 404.
pat-eng: Replaced anchor with /docs/console/presets/canonical and updated caption. Pushed commit.
ci-bot: PR #9786 link-check: 1 failed -> presets anchor (fixed in new commit).
dom-sdk: Pushed SDK snippet update (node + py). Kept examples minimal and added a one-line migration note: "Legacy SDKs may emit `trace_key`; map to `traceId`."
sylvia-ml: Add a short note about telemetry.v1 nesting (some payloads put metrics under `telemetry.v1.metrics`). Saves support tickets.
nora-docs: Added nesting note and updated alt text. Re-ran link-check locally.
ci-bot: PR #9786 checks: all passed.
nora-docs: Merged. If anyone spots other orphaned refs, please file a follow-up. :thumbsup:
